atoms.source_line: Patients must satisfy this criteria based on the portion of the study for which they are being considered for enrollment:

atoms.source_line: Dose Escalating Phase: Patients with advanced solid tumor malignancies for whom single-agent pemetrexed therapy would not be contraindicated. Measurable disease not required.
atoms.question: Is single‑agent pemetrexed therapy contraindicated for this patient?

atoms.source_line: Phase 2 portion: Current diagnosis of Stage IIIb (due to malignant pleural effusion or supraclavicular lymph node involvement only) or Stage IV histologically and/or cytologically proven non-small cell lung cancer according to staging system of the American Joint Committee on Cancer.

children.question: Is the disease stage IIIB with malignant pleural effusion or supraclavicular node involvement only?
Is the patient diagnosed with stage IV non‑small cell lung cancer?

atoms.question: Does the patient meet either the stage IIIB with effusion or stage IV NSCLC criteria?

atoms.source_line: (i) Patient has received maximally feasible surgical resection and/or radiotherapy for initial disease.
atoms.question: Has the patient received maximal surgical resection and/or radiotherapy for the initial disease?

atoms.source_line: (ii) Either disease progression following treatment with one prior chemotherapy regimen used for the treatment of metastatic disease or disease progression following adjuvant/neoadjuvant therapy within one year of last dose of chemotherapy or (for those patients with disease progression following adjuvant/neoadjuvant therapy >1 year of last dose of chemotherapy) disease progression following one additional chemotherapy regimen for metastatic disease.
atoms.question: Has the patient experienced disease progression after the specified prior chemotherapy regimens?

atoms.source_line: (iii) Radiographic or physical examination evidence of at least one site of unidimensionally-measurable disease, using the RECIST criteria with disease assessed within 28 days prior to treatment initiation.
